codeReview.summary: Feature m2-f6 is a TDD-only commit: 13 DOM tests in a single new file (`tests/unit/renderer/agentModeSelector.dom.test.tsx`). No production code was modified. The tests comprehensively cover all three AgentModeSelector surfaces (GuidActionRow pre-conversation, ChatLayout header pill, AcpSendBox compact pill) for: (1) Mission menuitem visibility with `data-key='mission'` when `backend='droid'`, (2) Mission hidden for non-droid backends (`qwen`), (3) correct IPC call shape `setMode.invoke({ conversationId, mode: 'mission' })` for in-conversation surfaces, (4) `onModeSelect('mission')` callback for GuidActionRow, (5) compact pill label rendering via `modeLabelFormatter`, and (6) SkipPermissionsConfirmModal (YOLO modal) NOT mounting when mission is selected. Tests pass (13/13), tsc clean, lint clean, format clean.
